name: Verification Feedback Loop
processed_text: How autonomous coding agents improve reliability through implementation, test execution, failure inspection, correction, and verification. The agent makes a change, runs tests, observes failures, feeds the failure back as context, corrects the implementation, and verifies the fix.

evidence.excerpt: Agents that implement a verification feedback loop show 40% fewer production bugs compared to agents that generate code without verification.
The loop consists of: implement -> test -> inspect failure -> correct -> verify. Each iteration reduces error rate.
